caseNameFull: BISENIUS v. KARNS, COMMISSIONER OF MOTOR VEHICLES
attorneys: S. A. Schapiro for appellant., Robert W. Warren, Attorney General of Wisconsin, and Albert Harriman and Robert D. Martinson, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
